payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the model over state-of-the-art systems, including percentage increases in F1-scores and comparisons with previous models.

claims.text: The model improved the macro-average F1-score by over 7 percent compared to previous state-of-the-art systems.
The model achieved a performance boost of 3.02 in macro F1-scores for implicit discourse relations compared to previous models.
The model outperformed previous neural tensor network models by more than 2 percent in macro-average F1-score.
The model achieved F1-score improvements of 6 points on Comparison and 7 points on Temporal relations compared to the best previous systems.
